sentences.en: This development was not foreseeable; it simply surprised us.
sentences.zh: 这个发展无法预知；它只是让我们感到惊讶。

sentences.en: The language is not expected to die for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 这种语言在未来可预见的时间内不会消亡。

sentences.en: At the present moment, not all consequences of the scandal are foreseeable.
sentences.zh: 目前来看，这场丑闻的所有后果都无法预料。

senses.zh: 可预知的, 能预测的, 能看透的。
